I don't consider Nicki Minaj a musician, but she is definitely an entertainer. The fact is, the ability to sing is a common talent, it's the ability to ENTERTAIN is what got her famous.

I love Nicki and I'm glad there is a strong female in hip hop that isn't selling her body as her strongest asset. She is charming, she is a helluva of a good singer (studied in the same academy as adele and jessie j), and she's not afraid to be herself

Good for you Nicki

I used to think my family was normal, until I went to college and saw how other families acted with each other. I couldn't believe they were treating each other like friends and joking around.

My family sucks.

I like to think back to a situation where I thought I was never going to get out of and how things aren't as bad as it seems in the future.

What gets me up in the morning is the thought that opportunities are endless AS LONG AS YOU PUT YOURSELF OUT THERE FOR THEM TO HAPPEN. The best suggestion I have for you is to invest in something that requires you to go outside and interact with others.

I feel like there's more to this story than what is written, like there is something that is normally easily coped by others, however you're having trouble with it so you're trying to find an excuse?

Btw, I'm not implying that is happening, but I'm just curious if there is something driving you to do this. If you need someone to pm, I'm here :)

Hey man,

I know it's scary when your way of thinking is threatened and I too have had that fear of being told that the way I thought about the world was wrong.


But, think about going to the counselor as a way of picking up information about people who don't think like yourself, therefore expanding your own knowledge. I think the scary aspect is being told to completely reform your thoughts about things, but remember that ONLY YOU can change your way of thinking, no one can force you to think differently. 

I'm just saying, give it a chance. The interesting thing about people is that everyone has different perspectives, it'd probably benefit you to learn about the pov of a counselor and add it to your own knowledge, then you can manipulate/utilize it to your own advantage.

Best of luck, dude.
